en_title: Chris Pratt Reaffirms Star-Lord Will Return in the MCU and Plans Are Being Made Right Now
cn_title: 克里斯·帕拉特确认星爵将回归漫威宇宙
subtitle: 他不会就此离场
opus_summary: 克里斯·帕拉特确认，漫威正持续讨论并采取行动，兑现星爵回归的承诺，但暂未透露具体时间。星爵自2023年以来未再登场，目前也不在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》已确认的演员名单中，回归形式仍未明朗。

paragraphs.en: Chris Pratt has confirmed that Star-Lord's return to the MCU is actively being figured out.
paragraphs.cn: 克里斯·帕拉特确认，漫威正在积极筹划星爵回归漫威电影宇宙。

paragraphs.en: The beloved galactic hero has been absent from the MCU since 2023, but his last appearance ended with a promise during the credits: Star-Lord will return. When speaking with The Playlist , Chris Pratt was asked about Star-Lord's future. Pratt confirmed that Marvel has been having conversations about bringing back the character, but he's remaining tight-lipped on when that will happen.
paragraphs.cn: 这位深受喜爱的银河英雄自2023年以来就没有在漫威电影宇宙中登场，但他上次亮相时，片尾字幕给出了一个承诺：星爵将回归。克里斯·帕拉特接受The Playlist采访时，被问到了星爵的未来。帕拉特证实，漫威一直在讨论如何让这个角色回归，但他没有透露回归时间。

paragraphs.en: “I have a great relationship with Kevin [Feige] and Lou [D’Esposito], and there have been both ongoing conversations about how we make good on that promise and also hard action taken to make sure that we make good on that promise,” he explained. “So yeah, you’ll see Star-Lord again, which is very exciting, but I’m not at liberty to say when that’s going to be, but he’s not going anywhere.”
paragraphs.cn: 他解释道：「我和Kevin[Feige]、Lou[D’Esposito]关系很好。我们一直在讨论如何兑现这个承诺，也已经采取了切实行动，确保承诺能够兑现。」他接着说：「所以，没错，你们会再次看到星爵，这令人非常兴奋。但我不能透露具体时间，不过他不会就此离场。」

paragraphs.en: Of course, Avengers: Doomsday is right around the corner and has a stacked cast... but Pratt is not among the list of confirmed stars. There are some actors who are heavily rumored to appear , but haven't been officially announced. However, Pratt hasn't really been part of the rumor mill. It's possible that he will be in the film's sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars , but we will likely have to wait until next year to know for sure.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》即将上映，演员阵容也相当豪华……但帕拉特并未出现在已确认的演员名单中。虽然有些演员被广泛传将参演，却尚未获得官方宣布，但帕拉特并没有出现在相关传闻中。他有可能参演这部电影的续集《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》，但我们或许要等到明年才能确定。

paragraphs.en: Director James Gunn has been open about having no plans to do another Guardians of the Galaxy film , especially since he is now heading up DC Studios. Still, many of the characters he adapted for the big screen still live on in the MCU. Perhaps Star-Lord will get his own TV series. Maybe a solo film... or maybe he will return with a new crew in a potential Guardians of the Galaxy 4, helmed by another director. There are a ton of possibilities, but you can rest assured knowing Star-Lord is coming back.
paragraphs.cn: 导演James Gunn已明确表示，没有计划再拍一部《银河护卫队》电影，尤其是他如今正执掌DC Studios。不过，他曾改编搬上大银幕的许多角色仍活跃在漫威电影宇宙中。星爵或许会拥有自己的剧集，也可能推出个人电影……又或者，他会在可能由另一位导演执导的《银河护卫队4》中，与一支新队伍一同回归。回归方式有很多种，但可以确定的是，星爵会回来。
